newsitem.title: FRANCE: France, Canada back Boutros for Francophonie head.
newsitem.headline: France, Canada back Boutros for Francophonie head.

text.p: France and Canada back former United Nations chief Boutros Boutros-Ghali's bid to head the 46-state Francophonie group, French President Jacques Chirac's spokeswoman said on Friday.

The group of French-speaking countries is to appoint a secretary-general at its November summit in Hanoi, hoping that putting a well-known international figure at the helm will give it a bigger say in international affairs.

Spokeswoman Catherine Colonna, speaking to reporters after a meeting between Chirac and Canada's Governor General Romeo Leblanc, said both backed a bid by Canada's New Brunswick province to host Francophonie's next summit, in 1999.
